SOURCE: William Fong, "J.W. McConnell: Financier, Philanthropist, Patriot"
        (Montreal: McGill-Queen's University Press, 2008).
        Internet Archive item jwmcconnellfinan0000fong, scan leaf 766.
        The book is lending-restricted and print-disabled; it CANNOT be read whole from here.

HOW THIS TEXT WAS OBTAINED, and what it therefore is:
  Open Library's search-inside endpoint returns a highlighted window of about a dozen words
  around a matched phrase, for restricted books as well as open ones. Seven overlapping phrase
  queries were run on 2026-09-06 and their windows joined. This file is THAT RECONSTRUCTION,
  not a transcription of the page and not a facsimile. The printed page number is unknown;
  766 is the scan leaf. Nothing before or after the passage below has been read.

QUERIES RUN, in order, each returning one window from this item:
  "Camp Kanawana"                          -> "...for a new Camp Kanawana, which was renamed"
  "which was renamed Lake Wilson after"    -> "...for a new Camp Kanawana, which was renamed Lake Wilson after his first son. Lurther, the"
  "Wilson after his first son"             -> "...Kanawana, which was renamed Lake Wilson after his first son. Lurther, the YMC A campaign provided"
  "near Saint-Sauveur, for a new"          -> "...bought a site at Lake Desjardins, near Saint-Sauveur, for a new Camp Kanawana, which was renamed"
  "bought a site at Lake Desjardins"       -> "1912, in that year he also bought a site at Lake Desjardins, near Saint-Sauveur, for a new"
  "campaign provided" "Kanawana"           -> "...his first son. Lurther, the YMC A campaign provided the model for a fundraising campaign"
  "model for a fundraising campaign"       -> "...YMC A campaign provided the model for a fundraising campaign of McGill University, also in"

THE PASSAGE AS RECONSTRUCTED (OCR artefacts preserved and marked):

  ... 1912, in that year he also bought a site at Lake Desjardins, near Saint-Sauveur,
  for a new Camp Kanawana, which was renamed Lake Wilson after his first son.
  Lurther[= Further], the YMC A[= YMCA] campaign provided the model for a fundraising
  campaign of McGill University, also in ...

NOTES ON READING IT
  - "Lurther" is OCR for "Further"; the F has been read as an L. "YMC A" is a spacing artefact.
  - The sentence begins mid-clause. What precedes "1912, in that year he also" has not been read,
    so what else McConnell did in 1912 is unknown here, and the antecedent of "he" is McConnell
    only by the subject matter of the book.
  - "his first son" is not named. This project identifies him as Wilson Griffith McConnell
    (1908-1966) on the family record; Fong does not write the name in this window.
  - The passage does not say whether the purchase and the renaming happened in the same year,
    nor whether he bought the lake or the whole site.
